QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/...`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States env overrides first, then the default user directory, then the system library cache (`find_library`). It also names the nested and flat layouts, though only for `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, which is close enough to the item's two layouts per root.
